system_power_assumptions.regeneration_logic: Battery accepts only when charge/SOC/temperature permits; full battery or disconnected pack needs hardware bus clamp and rated dump load. Do not rely on bulk capacitor, fuse, or ordinary buck converter to absorb braking energy.
system_power_assumptions.power_estimate_scope: Illustrative moving-load estimate only. Mechanical-power limiting does not bound zero-speed winding losses or driver/buck transients. Actual bus-current sensing, calibrated winding-loss model and thermal tests are required;40A is a proposed harness requirement, not a validated worst-case current.

pcb_design_requirements.isolation: USB VBUS backfeed prevention; common signal reference on motor/CAN side; CAN isolation candidate in existing interface allocation
pcb_design_requirements.motor_connector_branching: No daisy-chained small connector carries the entire17-axis bus; fuse/limit branches after main disconnect
pcb_design_requirements.reservation_definition: main_protection93g + servo_buck40g; includes5Vservo converter; not a confirmed fit for a final resistor/contactor design
